headline: 162* not out: Shai Hope leads Windies to record chase against India
summary: Overcoming a groin injury, the West Indies skipper smashed a century to secure a five-wicket victory in the final ODI of the series.
details: West Indies secured a consolation five-wicket victory over India in the final one-day international on Saturday, led by a masterful 162 not out from skipper Shai Hope.
Hope overcame a groin injury and a sudden role change to open the batting after Jewel Andrew suffered a finger injury, orchestrating a record-breaking chase.
India had posted a mammoth 351-7, powered by KL Rahul's career-best unconquered 129 and a breezy 92 by Rohit Sharma.
Hope's innings was a masterclass in stroke play, including a ferocious onslaught where he smashed 40 runs off his final 16 deliveries to seal the win with 10 balls to spare.
The West Indies' previous highest successful chase was 331-5 against Ireland in 2019, now surpassed by the record-breaking effort in New Chandigarh.
Earlier in the match, Jayden Seales provided early breakthroughs by dismissing Shubman Gill and Virat Kohli in quick succession.
Despite the loss, India won the three-match series 2-1, as they had already taken a 2-0 lead going into the final game.
caption:
A record-breaking chase and a battle against injury! Shai Hope's 162* takes West Indies to a stunning victory over India.

West Indies secured a consolation five-wicket victory over India in the final one-day international on Saturday, led by a masterful 162 not out from skipper Shai Hope.

Hope overcame a groin injury and a sudden role change to open the batting after Jewel Andrew suffered a finger injury, orchestrating a record-breaking chase.

India had posted a mammoth 351-7, powered by KL Rahul's career-best unconquered 129 and a breezy 92 by Rohit Sharma.

Hope's innings was a masterclass in stroke play, including a ferocious onslaught where he smashed 40 runs off his final 16 deliveries to seal the win with 10 balls to spare.

The West Indies' previous highest successful chase was 331-5 against Ireland in 2019, now surpassed by the record-breaking effort in New Chandigarh.

Earlier in the match, Jayden Seales provided early breakthroughs by dismissing Shubman Gill and Virat Kohli in quick succession.

Despite the loss, India won the three-match series 2-1, as they had already taken a 2-0 lead going into the final game.

headline: 6 deaths, 1,608 hospitalizations in 24 hours as dengue surges
summary: Health officials report a sharp rise in cases and fatalities, with Dhaka South City Corporation area seeing the highest death toll this year.
details: Six people died and 1,608 others were admitted to hospitals across Bangladesh in a single 24-hour period, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
The surge in cases has put significant pressure on healthcare facilities, with 1,608 patients requiring hospitalization in just one day.
So far this year, 256 people have died from dengue, with the Dhaka South City Corporation area recording the highest number of fatalities at 72.
The month of September alone saw 148 deaths nationwide, highlighting a peak in the transmission of the virus.
A total of 84,369 dengue patients have been hospitalized this year, while 78,482 patients have recovered and returned home.
caption:
